backups.enableCadence: Enable at least one automatic cadence to schedule backups.
backups.backupQueued: Backup is queued and will start shortly.
backups.waitingScheduler: Waiting for the scheduler to pick up the next backup.
backups.waitingFirstBackup: Waiting for the first backup; scheduler will run ASAP.
backups.shouldHaveRun: Should have already run; scheduler will retry automatically.
backups.selectInstanceManage: Select an instance to manage backups
backups.noInstancesConfigured: No qBittorrent instances configured. Add an instance first to use the backup feature.
backups.noInstancesDesc: No instances configured. Add a qBittorrent instance in Settings to manage backups.
backups.checkingCapabilities: Checking which instances support torrent backups.
backups.chooseInstance: Choose a qBittorrent instance from the dropdown above to view and manage its backups.
backups.noCompatibleUpgrade: None of your qBittorrent instances support torrent backups yet. Upgrade to qBittorrent 4.5.0+ (Web API 2.8.11+) to enable this feature.
backups.backupsUnavailableDesc: qBittorrent Web API 2.8.11+ (qBittorrent 4.5.0+) is required to export .torrent files for backups. This instance reports {{reportedVersion}}, so torrent exports are disabled.
backups.enableBackupsDesc: Turn on automatic backups for this instance. Pick at least one cadence below; leave this off for manual-only backups.
backups.includeCategoriesDesc: Group torrents inside the archive by their category
backups.includeTagsDesc: Store torrent tags in the manifest
backups.automaticCadencesDesc: Hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly runs start after the previous backup finishes and their interval has elapsed. Leave them all off if you only trigger backups manually.
backups.hourlyDesc: Runs roughly once per hour when backups are enabled and at least an hour has passed since the last run.
backups.hourlyKeepDesc: How many hourly snapshots to keep before older ones are pruned.
backups.dailyDesc: Runs about once every 24 hours after the previous job finishes.
backups.dailyKeepDesc: How many daily snapshots to keep before rotation.
backups.weeklyDesc: Runs once the last backup is at least seven days old.
backups.weeklyKeepDesc: How many weekly snapshots to keep before rotation.
backups.monthlyDesc: Runs when the previous run is from an earlier calendar month.
backups.monthlyKeepDesc: How many monthly snapshots to keep before rotation.
backups.selectCadence: Select at least one cadence to enable automatic backups.
backups.waitForCapabilityCheck: Wait for instance capability checks to finish before saving to all instances.
backups.selectCadenceBeforeSave: Select at least one cadence (hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly) before saving.
backups.changesApplyImmediately: Changes apply to future backups as soon as you save.
backups.incrementalDesc: Adds missing categories, tags, and torrents without touching existing data.
backups.overwriteDesc: Adds missing items and updates existing categories/torrents to match the snapshot.
backups.completeDesc: Same as overwrite, then removes anything not recorded in the backup.
backups.autoResumeDesc: When enabled, torrents resume automatically if qBittorrent reports the restored data as fully checked. In other words; no data is missing.
backups.autoResumeOn: Torrents will resume automatically once qBittorrent reports the restored data as fully checked.
backups.autoResumeOff: Auto resume is off. Torrents stay paused until you start them manually.
backups.enableSkipRecheck: Enable skip recheck to allow automatic resume after verification.
backups.noChangesRequired: No changes are required for this restore mode.
backups.importBackupDesc: Upload a backup archive (with torrent files) or manifest.json (metadata only). Archive formats: zip, tar.gz, tar.zst, tar.br, tar.xz, tar.
backups.deleteAllBackupsDesc: This removes every stored backup archive and manifest for this instance. This action cannot be undone.
backups.deleteBackupDesc: This will remove the backup archive and manifest from disk. This action cannot be undone.
backups.noBackupsOnPage: No backups on this page. Use pagination to go back.
backups.noBackupsCreated: No backups have been created yet.
backups.selectBackupViewManifest: Select a backup to view its manifest
backups.name: Name

crossSeed.title: Cross-Seed
crossSeed.description: Identify compatible torrents and automate cross-seeding across your instances.
crossSeed.noActiveInstances: No active instances. Add instances first.
crossSeed.hardlinkReflinkDesc: Create hardlinked or reflinked (copy-on-write) file trees for cross-seeds. Each instance can be configured independently. The base directory must be on the same filesystem as the instance's download paths.
crossSeed.reflinkModeDesc: allows safe cross-seeding of torrents with extra/missing files. When extra files are present, qui triggers a recheck; if below threshold, the torrent stays paused for manual review.
crossSeed.enableLocalAccess: Enable "Local filesystem access" in Instance Settings to use hardlink or reflink modes.
crossSeed.regularDesc: Reuse existing files in place. Fast, no extra disk space.
crossSeed.hardlinkDesc: Create hardlinked file trees. No extra disk space, strict piece-boundary check.
crossSeed.reflinkDesc: Create reflinked clones. Safer for extra/missing files, mitigates corruption best.
crossSeed.baseDirectoriesDesc: Comma-separated paths. The first directory on the same filesystem as the source will be used.
crossSeed.fallbackToRegular: Fallback to regular mode on error
crossSeed.fallbackDesc: If {{mode}} fails (e.g., different filesystems), fall back to regular mode using existing files.
crossSeed.addIndexerHint: {{context}} Add at least one enabled indexer in Settings → Indexers.
crossSeed.searchNeedTorznab: Seeded Torrent Search needs Torznab indexers (unless you are only scanning OPS/RED via Gazelle).
crossSeed.rssNeedTorznab: RSS automation runs require at least one Torznab indexer.
crossSeed.selectInstanceForRss: Select at least one instance for RSS automation.
crossSeed.customCategoryRequired: Custom category mode requires a category name
crossSeed.configureTorznabFirst: Configure at least one Torznab indexer before running RSS automation.
crossSeed.selectInstanceBeforeRun: Select at least one instance before running RSS automation.
crossSeed.automationInProgress: Automation run is already in progress.
crossSeed.manualRunCooldown: Manual runs are limited to every {{interval}}-minute interval. Try again in {{cooldown}}.
crossSeed.saveRssBeforeRun: Save RSS automation settings to apply the updated target instances before running.
crossSeed.enableGazelleFirst: Enable Gazelle matching (OPS/RED) before running with Torznab disabled.
crossSeed.configureTorznabOrGazelle: Configure at least one Torznab indexer, or enable Gazelle matching for OPS/RED torrents.
crossSeed.selectInstanceToRun: Select an instance to run against
crossSeed.torznabMissingDesc: RSS automation needs at least one enabled Torznab indexer. Seeded Torrent Search can still run OPS/RED matches via Gazelle if enabled.
crossSeed.rssAutomationDesc: Hands-free polling of tracker RSS feeds using your rules.
crossSeed.seededSearchDesc: Deep scan the torrents you already seed to backfill gaps.
crossSeed.rssAutomationTitleDesc: Poll tracker RSS feeds on a fixed interval and add matching cross-seeds automatically.
crossSeed.rssIntervalDesc: Automation processes the full feed from every enabled Torznab indexer on each run. Minimum interval is {{min}} minutes to avoid hammering indexers.
crossSeed.pickInstanceForCrossSeeds: Pick at least one instance to receive cross-seeds.
crossSeed.allEnabledIndexers: All enabled indexers (leave empty for all)
crossSeed.allTorznabEligible: All enabled Torznab indexers are eligible for RSS automation.
crossSeed.selectedIndexersOnly: Only {{n}} selected indexer(s) will be polled.
crossSeed.selectInstancesToLoadCategories: Select target instances to load categories
crossSeed.selectedCategoriesOnly: Only {{n}} selected categor(y/ies) will be matched.
crossSeed.selectInstancesToLoadTags: Select target instances to load tags
crossSeed.selectedTagsOnly: Only {{n}} selected tag(s) will be matched.
crossSeed.noRssRunsRecorded: No RSS automation runs recorded yet.
crossSeed.webhookDesc: Filter which local torrents are considered when autobrr calls the /apply webhook endpoint.
crossSeed.emptyFiltersNote: Empty filters mean all torrents are checked. If you configure both category and tag filters, torrents must match both.
crossSeed.libraryScanDesc: Walk the torrents you already seed on the selected instance, collapse identical content down to the oldest copy, and query Torznab once per unique release. If Gazelle is enabled, RED/OPS API matching is also attempted.
crossSeed.runSparinglyDesc: This deep scan touches every torrent you seed and can stress trackers despite the built-in cooldowns. Prefer autobrr announces or RSS automation for routine coverage and reserve manual search runs for occasional catch-up passes.
crossSeed.intervalDesc: Wait time before scanning the next seeded torrent. Minimum {{min}} seconds.
crossSeed.intervalRecommended: Recommended 10s+; this is per-torrent pacing, and each torrent can trigger multiple Gazelle API calls.
crossSeed.cooldownDesc: Skip seeded torrents that were searched more recently than this window. Minimum {{min}} minutes.
crossSeed.categoriesLoadNote: Categories load after selecting an instance; you can still type a category name.
crossSeed.allCategoriesInScan: All categories will be included in the scan.
crossSeed.selectedCategoriesInScan: Only {{n}} selected categor(y/ies) will be scanned.
crossSeed.tagsLoadNote: Tags load after selecting an instance; you can still type a tag.
crossSeed.allTagsInScan: All tags will be included in the scan.
crossSeed.selectedTagsInScan: Only {{n}} selected tag(s) will be scanned.
crossSeed.addInstanceToSearch: Add an instance to search the torrents you already seed.
crossSeed.crossSeedRulesDesc: Settings that apply to all cross-seed operations.
crossSeed.gazelleDesc: Enable direct API matching against Orpheus and Redacted. This runs alongside Torznab; OPS/RED Torznab indexers are ignored.
crossSeed.enableGazelleDesc: Applies to all source torrents. If possible, qui also checks RED/OPS via Gazelle.
crossSeed.redKeyDesc: Used for redacted.sh lookups. Paste to replace; clear to remove.
crossSeed.opsKeyDesc: Used for orpheus.network lookups. Paste to replace; clear to remove.
crossSeed.matchingBehaviorDesc: Control how torrents are matched and which file differences are allowed.
crossSeed.sizeMismatchDesc: Maximum size difference for matching. Also sets auto-resume threshold (e.g., 5% = resume at ≥95%).
crossSeed.crossSeedEpisodesDesc: Your local season packs can match individual episode torrents on indexers, letting you seed both formats.
crossSeed.safetyValidationDesc: Control which matches proceed and protect your existing seeded data.
crossSeed.skipRecheckDesc: Skip matches needing rename alignment, extra files, or disc layouts (BDMV/VIDEO_TS). When this is OFF, those matches are force rechecked by default.
crossSeed.pieceBoundaryDisabled: Piece boundary safety check currently disabled
crossSeed.allowPieceBoundaryDesc: Allow matches even if extra files share pieces with content. May corrupt existing seeded files if content differs. Consider reflink mode instead.
crossSeed.blockPieceBoundaryDesc: Matches are blocked when extra files share pieces with content, protecting your existing seeded files.
crossSeed.categoriesDesc: Control how cross-seeds are categorized in qBittorrent.
crossSeed.reuseCategoryDesc: Cross-seeds use the exact same category as the matched torrent. In regular mode, AutoTMM mirrors the matched torrent; in hardlink/reflink mode, AutoTMM is disabled and an explicit save path is used.
crossSeed.reuseCategoryHelp: Information about reusing matched torrent category
crossSeed.keepCategoryUnchanged: Keep the matched torrent's category unchanged (no .cross suffix).
crossSeed.categoryAffixDesc: Creates isolated categories (e.g., cross-seed/movie or tv.cross). In regular mode, cross-seeds inherit AutoTMM from the matched torrent; in hardlink/reflink mode, AutoTMM is disabled and an explicit save path is used.
crossSeed.keepsArrSeparate: Keeps cross-seeds separate from *arr applications to prevent import loops.
crossSeed.useIndexerDesc: Creates a category named after the indexer. AutoTMM is disabled; save path is set to match the original torrent. Useful for tracking which indexer provided each cross-seed.
crossSeed.indexerCategoryHelp: Information about using indexer name as category
crossSeed.setCategoryToIndexer: Set category to the indexer name (e.g., TorrentDB, BroadcasTheNet).
crossSeed.customCategoryDesc: All cross-seeds will be placed in a single custom category. AutoTMM is disabled; save path is set to match the original torrent.
crossSeed.useFixedCategory: Use a fixed category name for all cross-seeds.
crossSeed.taggingDesc: Configure tags applied to cross-seed torrents based on how they were discovered.
crossSeed.rssTagsDesc: Tags applied to torrents added via RSS feed automation.
crossSeed.seededSearchTagsDesc: Tags applied to torrents added via seeded torrent search.
crossSeed.completionSearchTagsDesc: Tags applied to torrents added via completion-triggered search.
crossSeed.webhookTagsDesc: Tags applied to torrents added via /apply webhook (e.g., autobrr).
crossSeed.inheritSourceTagsDesc: Also copy tags from the matched source torrent in qBittorrent.
crossSeed.postInjectionDesc: Control what happens after cross-seed torrents are successfully injected.
crossSeed.autoResumeAfterInjection: Auto-resume after injection (when off, torrents stay paused for review)
crossSeed.resumeSeededSearchAuto: Resume seeded search and dialog-injected torrents automatically
crossSeed.externalProgramDesc: Optionally run an external program after successfully injecting a cross-seed torrent. Only enabled programs are shown.
crossSeed.cancelRssRunDesc: This will stop the current RSS automation run. Any torrents already added will remain, but processing of new items will stop.
crossSeed.noLocalAccessInstance: Instance "{{name}}" does not have local filesystem access enabled.
crossSeed.baseDirectoryRequired: Base directory must be set first.
crossSeed.gazelleEnabledOpsOnly: Gazelle: enabled (OPS key set, RED missing)
crossSeed.gazelleEnabledRedOnly: Gazelle: enabled (RED key set, OPS missing)
crossSeed.allEnabledNonOpsRed: All enabled non-OPS/RED indexers (leave empty for all)
crossSeed.selectedTorznabGazelleOnly: Only {{n}} selected Torznab indexer(s) will be queried. Gazelle still checks RED/OPS.
crossSeed.selectedIndexersOnlyShort: Only {{n}} selected indexer(s) will be queried.
crossSeed.gazelleChecksAll: Gazelle checks RED/OPS for every source torrent. Torznab queries selected non-OPS/RED indexers.
crossSeed.gazelleChecksConfigured: Gazelle checks configured sites for every source torrent. Torznab queries selected indexers.
crossSeed.withoutGazelleNote: Without Gazelle, all matching relies on Torznab indexers.
crossSeed.enableGazelleBeforeRun: Enable Gazelle matching (OPS/RED) before running with Torznab disabled.
crossSeed.seededSearchNeedsTorznabOrGazelle: Seeded Torrent Search needs Torznab or Gazelle
crossSeed.configureTorznabOrGazelleForSearch: Configure at least one Torznab indexer, or enable Gazelle matching for OPS/RED torrents.
crossSeed.selectedTorznabAreGazelleOnly: Selected Torznab indexers are Gazelle-only (OPS/RED). This run will be Gazelle-only.
crossSeed.torznabDisabledGazelleWillCheck: Torznab disabled. Gazelle will check RED/OPS for every source torrent.
crossSeed.torznabDisabledEnableGazelleForSearch: Torznab disabled. Enable Gazelle (OPS/RED) to run Seeded Torrent Search in Gazelle-only mode.
crossSeed.onlyOpsRedTorznabNote: Only OPS/RED Torznab indexers are enabled. Torznab contributes nothing here; Gazelle still checks RED/OPS.
crossSeed.noNonOpsRedTorznabNote: No non-OPS/RED Torznab indexers. Gazelle will still check RED/OPS for every source torrent.
crossSeed.allNonOpsRedTorznabWillBeQueried: All enabled non-OPS/RED Torznab indexers will be queried. Gazelle also checks RED/OPS.
crossSeed.allEnabledTorznabWillBeQueried: All enabled Torznab indexers will be queried for matches.
